title: card.voltage Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response containing current voltage information and historical trend analysis.

alert.description: `true` if the Notecard is configured to add an entry to the `_health.qo` Notefile on USB connect/disconnect (enabled by sending `card.voltage` with `"usb": true, "alert": true`).

calibration.description: If a user calibration value has been saved (via `"set": true`), this is that value; otherwise it is the hardware-supplied default.

daily.description: Change in the 24-hour moving average over the analyzed window. Only present when historic voltage trend calculations have been enabled with `"on": true` and the analyzed window includes at least 24 hours of history.

hours.description: The number of hours of voltage history actually used in the analysis. Only present when historic voltage trend calculations have been enabled with `"on": true`.

minutes.description: The number of minutes since the Notecard was last on USB power. Not present when the Notecard is currently connected to USB power.

mode.description:
The current voltage-variable threshold value returned from Notecard.

For example, if the voltage threshold is `"usb:4.6;normal:3.5;dead:0"` and the power source returns a voltage of `3.9`, the mode value would be `"normal"`.

monthly.description: Change in the 30-day moving average over the analyzed window. Only present when historic voltage trend calculations have been enabled with `"on": true` and the analyzed window includes at least 30 days of history.

on.description: `true` if the request that produced this response set `"on": true`.

sync.description: `true` if the Notecard is configured to perform a sync on USB connect/disconnect (enabled by sending `card.voltage` with `"usb": true, "sync": true`).

usb.description: `true` if the Notecard is connected to USB power.

vavg.description: The average voltage during the analyzed window. Only present when historic voltage trend calculations have been enabled with `"on": true`.

vmax.description: The highest voltage during the analyzed window. Only present when historic voltage trend calculations have been enabled with `"on": true`.

vmin.description: The lowest voltage during the analyzed window. Only present when historic voltage trend calculations have been enabled with `"on": true`.

weekly.description: Change in the 7-day moving average over the analyzed window. Only present when historic voltage trend calculations have been enabled with `"on": true` and the analyzed window includes at least 7 days of history.

samples.title: Bare Request (USB-Powered, History Disabled)
samples.description: Minimal response from a bare `card.voltage` request on a USB-powered Notecard. No historical fields are present because trend analysis has not been enabled with `"on": true`.

samples.title: USB-Powered with Trends
samples.description: Response when Notecard is powered via USB and historic voltage trend calculations have been enabled with `"on": true`.

samples.title: Battery-Powered with Trends
samples.description: Response when Notecard is on battery and historic voltage trend calculations have been enabled with `"on": true`.

samples.title: Query Current Thresholds
samples.description: Response to a `card.voltage` request that includes `"mode": "?"`. The `mode` field carries the configured threshold definition string, not a bucket label.
